brief:
Shehab Wire describes Gaza as engulfed in successive waves of fire, with flames erupting across the territory from one area to another. The outlet characterizes the situation as an ongoing catastrophe, with the sky raining fire across the northern and southern regions as well as from east to west.

The report depicts the scale of destruction as sweeping across all directions of the Gaza Strip, with fires spreading continuously throughout the territory.

title: Gaza burning from north to south, Shehab Wire reports
